conditions.network: demo topology on network namespaces, FRR OSPF (hello 1 s, dead 4 s), tc netem + tbf, in a privileged container; net.ipv4.icmp_ratelimit=1000 on the routers

fault_values.route_drift: largest factor that changes a monitored path

conditions.isolation: serve ran in the efl-ems namespace as its own process; faults were applied by this script with tc, ip and vtysh directly on the device namespaces; results were read from alarm_log.csv only
